Lowering $w_{\text{align}}$ and raising $w_{\text{sid}}$ moves $\mathcal{N}_z$ away from $\mathcal{N}_{\text{emb}}$ at essentially no cost in $\mathcal{L}_{\text{rec}}$. \begin{table}[t]
\centering
\small
\caption{Is a refined neighbourhood worth it? Spam unlearning on Beauty (TIGER, bandwagon 1\%, $n_{\text{target}}{=}1$, \emph{mid} target; $\lambda_f{=}\lambda_s{=}0.1$, $\lambda_n{=}0.01$), mean\,$\pm$\,half-range over unlearning seeds $\{2,3,5\}$. Every $\mathcal{N}_z$ row USES the coherence term ($\lambda_n{=}0.01$); the refined space enters only through $\mathcal{L}_n$. \textbf{Upper block} is the state before this work: the shipped shared-SID-prefix neighbourhood and the pre-quantization top-$k$. The $\lambda_n{=}0$ row is not a competing neighbourhood -- $z$ is read only when $\lambda_n\neq0$, so $\mathcal{N}_z$ does not exist there. It instead BOUNDS what any neighbourhood can be worth: the whole $\mathcal{L}_n$ mechanism spans PGR $+0.970$ to $+0.987$, so the choice of neighbourhood competes for a share of $0.017$. \textbf{Lower block} is the refined space $z_i=\mathrm{MLP}([\mathrm{SIDEmb}(i),x_i])$ at two settings of its training weights (Tab.~\ref{tab:latent-geometry}), and the union. $\Delta$ columns are against $\mathcal{N}_{\text{emb}}$, the incumbent: a variant is worth adopting only if $\Delta$PGR $>0$ without a loss in UR. SH@10 (spam-hit rate) is the fraction of evaluation examples whose ground-truth label is not itself a deletion target but whose top-10 contains one; lower is better. UR $=$ N@10\,/\,N@10$_{\text{clean}}$ (N@10$_{\text{clean}}=0.03763$); PGR $=$ $(\text{SH}_{\text{poison}}{-}\text{SH})/(\text{SH}_{\text{poison}}{-}\text{SH}_{\text{clean}})$ with $\text{SH}_{\text{poison}}=0.01274$, $\text{SH}_{\text{clean}}=0.00000$; PGR $=1$ means spam exposure was pushed all the way down to the clean model. \emph{mid} is the only target with residual exposure once $\mathcal{L}_F$ has acted; on \emph{unpopular} and \emph{popular} PGR saturates at $+1.000$ for every arm, so no neighbourhood is distinguishable there.}
